exercises.title: 6. Pratique: Would / could for politeness and softeners

items.prompt: Soften: 'I want to discuss this.' → 'I ___ to discuss this.'
Soften: 'Can we meet tomorrow?' → '___ we meet tomorrow?'
items.hintAfterError: Para suavizar um pedido, troque o modal do presente pela forma mais educada (passado).

items.prompt: Soften: 'I think you're wrong.' → 'I ___ if we ___ see this differently.'
items.hintAfterError: Primeira lacuna: verbo que significa 'me pergunto' (começa com w); segunda: modal de possibilidade.

items.prompt: Soften: 'Tell me what happened.' → '___ you help me understand what happened?'
Soften: 'We need a mediator.' → 'I wonder if it ___ help to have a mediator.'
